notes.title: Tilt Brush v16: featuring new volumetric brushes, updated sound effects, and more!
notes.content:
We have an exciting new Tilt Brush update out today!

[b]New Brushes:[/b]
We’ve added 12 new brushes that expand your capabilities to create different textures and volumes.
One of our favorite new brushes, [b]Hull Brush[/b], is a new paradigm for volumetric modeling. With this new brush, you can create anything from a [url=https://poly.google.com/view/0wkL_VMw43D]natural landscape[/url] to more lifelike characters.

[b]Beginner vs. Advanced Mode:[/b]
As we keep expanding our Toolkit, we want to ensure that Tilt Brush is accessible to all experience levels. First time users of Tilt Brush will now start in Beginner Mode, which includes only the core feature set. When you open Tilt Brush after your first time, you will then be prompted to try all of the Tilt Brush Tools in the Advanced Mode. It is easy to switch between modes at any time with a quick press on the Mode Button.

[b]New Sound FX:[/b]
We launched an updated set of sound effects that integrate with your workflow. We have listened to your feedback and our revamped audio library retains Tilt Brush’s audio identity while creating a more pleasant creative environment.

[b]Additional Tools:[/b]
For our advanced users, we have added some additional tools to increase your productivity:

[list]
  [*][b]New Pin Tool:[/b] With the new Pin Tool, you can lock objects in place so that they are unselectable. This tool allows you to quickly pin or unpin many elements in a row. Just select the Pin Tool button in either the [url=https://support.google.com/tiltbrush/answer/6389713?ref_topic=7074683]Quick Tools Panel[/url] or the Labs Panel and pin away.
  [*][b]New selection options:[/b] We have added new two selection features, the Select All Tool and Invert Selection Tool. These allow you to select all items in a sketch as well as invert selections that you have made. Long press on the Selection Tool to access these features.
  [*][b]Recall Mirror tool:[/b] If you have ever lost your Mirror in a busy scene or teleported away from it in your sketch, you can use the Recall Mirror Tool by long pressing on the Mirror Tool. This will teleport it right next to you. 
  [*][b]Rapid undo/redo:[/b] If you want to undo a bunch of brush actions you can press and hold the undo controller button until the scene has reverted to the version you want. The same is now possible for redo.
[/list]

We’d love to see the art that you create with these new brushes and features! Share your projects using the [url=https://twitter.com/hashtag/TiltBrush?src=hash]#TiltBrush[/url]  hashtag, and we’ll highlight our favorites from [url=https://twitter.com/tiltbrush/]@TiltBrush[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/googlearvr/]@GoogleARVR[/url].

Happy painting!

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/11ZsHozYn9FnWG7y3s3WAyKIACfbfwb4PbaS8cZ_xjvo/preview#]Release Notes[/url]

notes.title: Tilt Brush v14: Blocks Library, Selection Tool, Quick Tool, and more!
notes.content:
We have an exciting new Tilt Brush update today!

[b]Blocks Library:[/b] Starting today, you can easily pull [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/533970/Blocks_by_Google/]Blocks[/url] objects directly into your Tilt Brush sketches, and share them back directly to the web. If you already use Blocks, those objects you publish to vr.google.com/objects will automatically show up inside of Tilt Brush. You can also find remixable Blocks models other people created on vr.google.com/objects. Browse objects on vr.google.com/objects and press “like” if you want an object from Blocks to be available in Tilt Brush. 

Our team has already started making some [url=https://vr.google.com/u/1/sketches/0R__aabI5P0]really[/url] [url=https://vr.google.com/sketches/eh3hedPtlq0]fun[/url] [url=https://vr.google.com/sketches/2M5OCeFLuKG]remixes[/url] using this new integration. Follow [url=https://twitter.com/tiltbrush]Tilt Brush on Twitter[/url] to see more examples of remixes in the coming weeks—if you publish a sketch that we like, there’s a good chance we’ll feature yours too!

[b]Selection Tool:[/b] You asked, we listened! With the new "Selection Tool", you can select and duplicate strokes and models in your scene. 
[list]
[*]“Selection” is found next to the “Eraser” button on the Tools panel.
[*]Select strokes using the trigger. You can also flip into deselect mode by tapping the thumbpad (Vive) or “A/X” button (Rift).
[*]If you want to move your selection, grab it as you would any other model in your scene. To delete a selected group of strokes, just throw it away.
[*]Duplicate selections by holding the thumbpad (Vive) or “A/X” button (Rift) while intersecting your controller with selected strokes.
[/list]
[b]Quick Tool:[/b] For those pro users out there, holding the “menu” button (Vive) or “Y/B” (Rift) on the controller now triggers a “Quick Tool” menu, letting you quickly swap tools without reaching back to the palette.

Along with these new features, we’ve also reshuffled icons on the palette, moved the user profile button to the Menu Panel, and introduced a new “More…” menu where we’re moving more advanced tools and features. If you’re looking for a Tool and can’t find it, don’t worry—we haven’t removed anything from the app! It’s likely hidden behind one of the “More...” menus, or under “Labs.” 

Happy painting!

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/11ZsHozYn9FnWG7y3s3WAyKIACfbfwb4PbaS8cZ_xjvo/preview#]Release Notes[/url]

notes.title: Tilt Brush v10: Share sketches to the online gallery!
notes.content:
Starting today, you can share Tilt Brush sketches directly to an online gallery. Sketches can be viewed at tiltbrush.com/sketches -- and sketches you 'like' on the web will show up in your sketchbook in Tilt Brush. 

Other updates include:
[list]
[*] New lighting panel: Change the light source locations and colors in your scene
[*] New backdrop panel: Change the backdrop color and fog intensity in your scene
[*] New environment presets: More preset environments to choose from
[*] New saving flow: Overwrite a sketch or Save New
[*] Ability to detach and move palette panels: Grab any panel on the palette and detach or move it
[/list]
[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/11ZsHozYn9FnWG7y3s3WAyKIACfbfwb4PbaS8cZ_xjvo/preview#] Release notes [/url]

notes.title: Happy Holidays from Tilt Brush (v8.0)
notes.content:
Happy Holidays! A few new features coming your way from the Tilt Brush team: 

Guides: Our newest set of art tools, “Guides”, allow you to create perfect shapes in Tilt Brush. Using a combination of cubes, spheres, and pill shapes, you can create everything from the solar system to a dining room chair with newfound precision. 

Sharing to YouTube: Once you’ve made a sketch, you can now quickly share a video of it to YouTube through our streamlined export feature. Just take a video and hold down the YouTube button, and you’re moments away from seeing your video up on YouTube. 

We’re keeping an eye out for videos uploaded to YouTube with the #TiltBrush hashtag, and will be adding some of the most impressive videos to the official GoogleVR playlist!

Other updates include...
[list]
[*] Straightedge now shows the final stroke you’re painting.
[*] Improvements to imported models, including support for FBX.
[*] Added in-app instructions for skipping the intro tutorial.
[*] 360 video export (for power users).
[*] Various bug fixes.
[/list]
[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/11ZsHozYn9FnWG7y3s3WAyKIACfbfwb4PbaS8cZ_xjvo/preview#]Release notes[/url]

notes.title: Tilt Brush v6: featuring audio reactive brushes!
notes.content:
Now, with audio reactive brushes, your sketches will bounce, sway, move and pulse to the beat. Just play audio on your computer from any source, enable audio reactive mode, and create your own VR music visualizer.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uFzAB4mr3KI]Tilt Brush: Audio Reactive Brushes (video)[/url]

Other notable changes:
[list]
[*] Fifteen new brushes
[*] New video capture feature (through “Cameras” tool)
[*] New “Sketchbook” panel, located below Tools 
[*] New “Tips ‘N Tricks” tutorial section 
[*] Streamlined panels down to three
[*] Export supports textured FBX files
[*] Various bug fixes, UX improvements, etc.
[/list]

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/11ZsHozYn9FnWG7y3s3WAyKIACfbfwb4PbaS8cZ_xjvo/edit]Full Release Notes[/url]

Version 1.4 released! This update includes the highly requested Teleport Tool, the ability to view YouTube Live chat while streaming, and, of course, a healthy dose of bug fixes and polish.

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/11ZsHozYn9FnWG7y3s3WAyKIACfbfwb4PbaS8cZ_xjvo/preview]Full release notes[/url]

notes.title: Tilt Brush v1.3 update
notes.content:
Today we’re releasing our first update since launch! This update includes a number of bug fixes and new features, including: 
[list]
[*] Ability to view .jpgs and .pngs as Reference Images
[*] New “Labs” panel for advanced and experimental features
[/list]
[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/11ZsHozYn9FnWG7y3s3WAyKIACfbfwb4PbaS8cZ_xjvo/preview] Full release notes[/url]

notes.title: Tilt Brush 1.2 update
notes.content:
Tilt Brush has been updated to version 1.2!

This update consists primarily of under-the-hood engine upgrades. It also includes many polish and performance improvements, one completely new kind of brush, and an upgrade to the Snapshot tool.

Snapshot is now the [b]Multi Cam[/b]. Swipe to choose between HD snapshots and animated gifs. As always, the pictures you take are saved to [b]My Documents\Tilt Brush\Snapshots[/b].

Enjoy!
